originality.rationale: FAIL by direct implication from the already-published complete root classification in Melman 2026 Theorem 3.1. Even if Melman uses different vocabulary and does not print the same normal form, the whole claim follows mechanically from its stronger explicit-zeros theorem. Finding no matching words in index searches cannot rescue covered corollaries.
